svg.aria-label: Calibration order: after connecting earth ground and placing the calibration cell in the shield, first run the required Calibrate Instrument. Then, as needed, run DC Low I (when sample impedance is very high; it must come after Calibrate Instrument and use the same cable), cable capacitance calibration (when the phase shows glitches) and temperature measurement calibration (when using a thermocouple). Send the instrument back to Gamry for factory calibration every 1 to 2 years.

text.style: fill:rgb(19, 28, 38);fill-opacity:1;stroke:none;stroke-opacity:1;stroke-width:1px;stroke-dasharray:none;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700

svg.text: Run Calibrate Instrument first; other three as needed
